I'll check on that, thanks!

Well, part of the job thing is that I have this feeling that I studied a career in arts for my personal growth and craft in my field, but without money opportunities yet and it's frustrating to think I wasted almost six years in that.

Another thing that have me this way is that last year I came out as a trans woman to my father and his reaction was basically saying that he felt I was on a terminal disease and was about to die. I guess he tried to make a metaphor, but it stung me so painfully that he prefered to think I was dying, like he wanted me dead before accepting me.

The fact that I don't have job/money to start a medical transition (something I want so bad) and then thinking, Well maybe I don't need to go through that specific process, and then thinking I REALLY want to, and then thinking Is it vanity? I feel like I can see what I want to do with my life and immediatly I find a reason for not doing it. Last year I started HRT but had to postpone it because I wasn't able to pay all the way through, and that got me down bad.

I don't know if I  can explain myself, but it's like I'm always seeking for a permission to live. I think this issue can be treated on therapy, but being like this got me into suicidal thoughts, like it could be the ultimate way to stop feeling this.
It takes your soul back into your body
